correctness.rationale: The source local estimate becomes uniform convergence G_r->exp after the exact scale eta=zeta/L_r because delta(r)->infinity. On every disk compactly contained in |zeta|<pi, exp is injective. If injectivity of G_r failed along a sequence, either the colliding points had distinct limits, contradicting injectivity of exp, or they coalesced, in which case derivative convergence makes the difference quotient tend to the nonzero value exp(zeta). The witness F(z)=exp(exp z) has L=e^r, satisfies the source regularity condition with delta=e^(r/2)/2, and has exact collisions at rescaled radius L*arcsin(pi/L)->pi.
